channel.title: Kali :: SE How-To Build Lab
channel.description: IMPORTANT:This page is a work in progress Download Kali ISO Kali Pre-Built VMs - QEMU Download and unzip Import the Kali qcow2 file Create Kali VM If you get the error No route to host with any of the following steps, use the Troubleshoot Ansible steps ​ RDP to OOB from Terminal in OOB cd /home/fortinet/automation/ansible/ubuntu ./create_kali.sh ../vars/all-hosts.yml <PVE server name> kali <qcow2 file name> ./start_stop_remove_vm.sh ../vars/all-hosts.yml <PVE server name> kali started Configure Kali NICs ​ via console tab in Proxmox Login - Default Username/Password : kali/kali
